name: Those Who Remain
source:
You are an undead, hunting the Sorceress who once claimed your life. You cannot remember your life before, and until your killer is dead, you can’t be free. At your side is the Sun Knight who once raised you from the dead, as well as others who want the Sorceress dead. An ardous journey nears its end, but not every end might be as simple as it seems.

[From [url=https://sealcat.itch.io/those-who-remain]itch.io[/url]]
